Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 18 · NFL Week 6 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 17, 10:56 PM ET

Dak Prescott has the highest SPAGS projection in the Cowboys at Packers DraftKings Showdown: 19.4 points at $10,400 FLEX, 29.2 at captain for $15,600. Across 10,000 simulations Prescott holds 59% of the winning-lineup credit. Jordan Love holds the most, at 62%. The case against Prescott is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.0 points at a $10,400 FLEX salary, in a game with a 53.5-point total.

CeeDee Lamb has the largest captain share: 12.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Lamb at captain. The model gives him 9.1 targets on 35.0 routes. Christian Watson is the next captain in line, at 12.2%. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 30.3 routes.

Green Bay is a 1.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 27.5 for the Packers and 26 for the Cowboys.

Behind Prescott, Lamb and Watson, the next projections are Jordan Love (18.9, $9,400), Javonte Williams (17.6, $9,600) and George Pickens (15.8, $8,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 17, 10:56 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: CeeDee Lamb, DAL WR ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

CeeDee Lamb holds 12.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 18.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.1 targets on 35.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 18.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 40.9. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.7% as the captain and 33.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Christian Watson, GB WR ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Christian Watson holds 12.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,500 and the 16.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 30.3 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Watson averaged 16.4 points with a simulated floor of 4.4 and a ceiling of 39.0. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.2% as the captain and 31.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: George Pickens, DAL WR ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

George Pickens holds 12.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 15.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 37.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Pickens averaged 15.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.1 and a ceiling of 38.1. He holds 42% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.1% as the captain and 29.6% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Cowboys vs Packers

Dak Prescott, DAL QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Dak Prescott carries the highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 19.4 DraftKings points for a $10,400 FLEX salary ($15,600 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Prescott averaged 19.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 37.2. He holds 59% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.3% as the captain and 48.9% in a FLEX spot.

Jordan Love, GB QB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Jordan Love carries the 2nd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 18.9 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Love averaged 18.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 36.5. He holds 62% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.6% as the captain and 51.3% in a FLEX spot.

Javonte Williams, DAL RB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Javonte Williams carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 17.6 DraftKings points for a $9,600 FLEX salary ($14,400 at captain). The model gives him 18.3 carries and 3.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 17.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.9 and a ceiling of 33.4. He holds 51% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.1% as the captain and 39.2% in a FLEX spot.

Matthew Golden, GB WR ($8,000 FLEX / $12,000 CPT)

Matthew Golden carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.1 DraftKings points for an $8,000 FLEX salary ($12,000 at captain). The model gives him 7.4 targets on 30.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Golden averaged 15.1 points with a simulated floor of 4.0 and a ceiling of 35.3. He holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.1% as the captain and 32.2% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Trey Smack, GB K ($4,800 FLEX / $7,200 CPT)

Trey Smack projects for 10.0 DraftKings points at a $4,800 FLEX salary, 2.09 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Smack averaged 10.2 points with a simulated floor of 4.6 and a ceiling of 17.2. He holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.3% as the captain and 34.3% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Ryan Flournoy, DAL WR ($4,400 FLEX / $6,600 CPT)

Ryan Flournoy projects for 8.5 DraftKings points at a $4,400 FLEX salary, 1.93 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 5.1 targets on 30.5 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Flournoy averaged 8.4 points with a simulated floor of 1.6 and a ceiling of 20.9. He holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.2% as the captain and 23.7% in a FLEX spot.

Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 12.7%, ahead of Christian Watson (12.2%) and George Pickens (12.1%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Cowboys vs Packers?

Build around Matthew Golden at captain with Jordan Love, Javonte Williams and Christian Watson at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (13 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $10,000 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown?

Dak Prescott leads the SPAGS model at 19.4 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 29.2 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Cowboys vs Packers Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb is the most expensive player at $10,800 FLEX and $16,200 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Cowboys vs Packers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Trey Smack (10.0 points at $4,800), Ryan Flournoy (8.5 points at $4,400) and Packers (4.9 points at $4,000).

What is the Cowboys vs Packers spread and total?

The Packers are a 1.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 53.5, with implied team totals of 27.5 for the Packers and 26 for the Cowboys.
